secrets.name: JWT_SECRET
secrets.description: Signing key for admin JWTs (any long random string).

secrets.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH
secrets.description: bcrypt hash of the shared admin password. Without it admin login always fails (viewer mode still works).

secrets.name: EMERGENT_LLM_KEY
secrets.description: Emergent universal key; used for Emergent object storage (photo/PDF uploads). Other features work without it.
